P3200 and P5990 are NOT the same project. They are two successive Virginia Natural Gas applications to the Virginia SCC:
  (a) HEADER IMPROVEMENT PROJECT (HIP) — three new 30-inch pipelines totalling ~24 mi (Transco Interconnect Pipeline 6.2 mi + Quantico Parallel Pipe 3.3 mi + Mechanicsville Parallel Pipe 14.6 mi = 24.1 mi), ~$346M, across Prince William, Fauquier, Hanover, New Kent and Charles City counties, sized for the proposed C4GT plant in Charles City County. DISMISSED by the SCC in December 2020 once C4GT's conditions could not be met.
  (b) VNG INTERCONNECT — the renamed, downsized successor filed 2020-12-14: ~10 mi (about 6 mi Prince William + 4 mi Fauquier, i.e. HIP's two northern segments with the 14.6 mi Mechanicsville leg dropped), 245 MMcf/d, $205M, plus a compressor station near Nokesville and Hanover metering upgrades. WITHDRAWN March 2021. This is EIA's single 'VNG Interconnect' row (Aug 2026, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 1143).
THIS ROW (P5990) HOLDS HIP'S DATA, NOT THE INTERCONNECT'S: 24 mi, 30 in, $346M, Prince William to Fauquier — and BOTH of its live-sheet refs are Header-Improvement-Project pages (Chesapeake Climate's 'Header Injustice Project' page; the Bay Journal's report of the SCC's Dec 1 2020 dismissal). P3200 holds the Interconnect's data (10 mi, 245 MMcf/d, $205M) and matches EIA.
THEREFORE THE DEFECT ON THIS ROW IS ITS NAME, NOT ITS NUMBERS. The row agent proposed the opposite — rewriting LengthKnown down to ~10 mi and SegmentCost down to $205M to match the name. That is rejected: it would make P5990 a second copy of P3200 and delete the Header Improvement Project — a real, separately-filed, separately-dismissed project — from the database entirely, while overwriting correctly-sourced values with another project's figures. KEEP BOTH ROWS; KEEP THIS ROW'S 24 mi / 30 in / $346M; CHANGE THIS ROW'S NAME.

validity.researcher_notes:
Project-history reconstruction from primary press sources: (1) VNG's original, larger proposal was the 'Header Improvement Project' (HIP) -- three new pipelines totaling 24 miles (Transco Interconnect Pipeline 6.2 mi + Quantico Parallel Pipeline 3.3 mi + Mechanicsville Parallel Pipeline 14.6 mi, all 30-inch diameter), spanning Prince William, Fauquier, Hanover, New Kent, and Charles City counties plus the City of Chesapeake, meant to supply the C4GT and Chickahominy gas power plants, at a cost the Bay Journal states explicitly as '$346 million' (bayjournal.com, 'Virginia board rejects application for natural gas pipeline expansion project'). The Virginia SCC REJECTED HIP on Dec. 1, 2020 (same Bay Journal article: 'the Dec. 1 decision to dismiss a request for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity... the Header Improvement Project'; VNG's own spokesperson is quoted saying the company was 'preparing' a new, separate filing). (2) That new filing -- reported by Virginia Mercury on 2020-12-16 as filed 'earlier this week' -- is a SMALLER, SCALED-DOWN project (the 'Interconnect Project' / GEM's 'VNG Interconnect'): 'The new project, estimated to cost $205 million, would add almost 10 miles of pipeline and an additional compressor station in Prince William County.' EIA's Aug 2026 release (sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 1143) independently states the identical figures for 'VNG Interconnect': 10 miles, $205 million, 245 MMcf/d, Cancelled. (3) The withdrawal notice for this SAME smaller project (Chesapeake Climate Action Network, 2021-03-23) states outright that 'VNG had planned to build the Interconnect in Northern Virginia primarily based off of plans from a previously cancelled project called the Header Improvement Project (HIP)' -- i.e. the Interconnect Project deliberately REUSED part of HIP's design (most likely the Transco Interconnect Pipeline 6.2 mi + Quantico Parallel Pipeline 3.3 mi = 9.5 mi, which rounds to Virginia Mercury's 'almost 10 miles' and EIA's 10 mi), while DROPPING the Mechanicsville Parallel Pipeline (14.6 mi) and the C4GT-specific scope. GEM's P5990 row is named/dated after the SMALLER project (title 'VNG Interconnect', CancelledYear 2021, matching the 2021-03-23 withdrawal) but its Length (24.00 mi) and SegmentCost ($346,000,000) values were sourced from documents describing the LARGER, EARLIER, REJECTED project (HIP) -- a genuine conflation of two sequential, differently-scoped filings that happen to share overlapping route segments and the same corporate sponsor. Diameter (30 in) is NOT flagged as an error: it is a per-segment physical spec (pipe diameter of the specific Transco Interconnect + Quantico Parallel segments), not a project-total aggregate, so it plausibly carries over unchanged between the two filings since the same physical pipe design was reused -- unlike Length and Cost, which are project-total sums that necessarily shrink when the Mechanicsville segment and C4GT-specific facilities are dropped.
